items.title: Gucci will show in Shanghai for the Cruise 2028 collection
items.summary: Gucci announced its Cruise 2028 show, Demna's first Asia presentation as creative director, will take place in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking 30 years since the brand's first mainland China store. The piece frames the choice explicitly as an attempt to reignite spending in China after a reported 5% sales decline and 8% revenue drop there.

items.title: Gucci selects Shanghai for Demna's Cruise 2028 fashion show
items.summary: Confirms Shanghai as the venue for Gucci's Cruise 2028 show under Demna, describing it as part of the house's broader push to rebuild relevance with Chinese consumers who increasingly expect more than recognizable logos. Notes Kering reported a 6% like-for-like Gucci sales decline in Q3, with China a key drag.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라... 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Covers Gucci global ambassador Park Bo-gum and aespa's Ningning attending the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala in custom Gucci looks, honoring artist Vija Celmins and director Denis Villeneuve. Largely descriptive activation coverage of styling choices with no independent critical verdict.

items.title: 박보검, 구찌 글로벌 앰버서더 선정 "기쁘고 기대된다"[공식]
items.summary: Official announcement that actor Park Bo-gum has been named Gucci's new global brand ambassador, with a quote expressing excitement about working within creative director Demna's aesthetic direction. Pure brand-staged announcement, descriptive only.

items.title: 구찌·에르메스 고전하는데...'코치'에 지갑 여는 젊은 소비자들
items.summary: Reports that Coach is posting strong growth in Korea (department-store payment volume up 70.4% Jan-Oct 2026) while Gucci and Hermes struggle, as budget-conscious younger consumers shift toward accessible-luxury alternatives priced $200-500. Explicit critical-angle piece naming Gucci among the laggards losing share to a mid-tier challenger.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어졌어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Reports organic consumer frustration after Gucci and Boucheron cut prices shortly following purchases at higher price points, quoting a community poster lamenting the lack of compensation for recent buyers. Frames the price cuts as creating reputational fallout among existing customers, not just a neutral pricing move.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데...루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's decision to cut handbag prices up to 30% against Louis Vuitton's continued refusal to follow, citing LVMH's fear of brand-value erosion even as its CFO recently acknowledged discussing price cuts internally. Frames Gucci's 13 consecutive quarters of sales decline as the proximate driver of the move.

items.title: 더쿠 - 구찌 살려... 톰포드: 구찌의 변화는 펀(Fun)하고 쿨(Cool)하고 섹시(Sexy)하게 대처할겁니다
items.summary: Korean community thread (더쿠) resurfacing Tom Ford-era commentary on Gucci's identity in the context of ongoing debate about whether Demna's direction has strayed from the brand's core appeal; comment threads skew skeptical about current direction versus past glory. Indicative of lingering 'lost its way' sentiment circulating in fan community discussion.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증) - 시계 갤러리
items.summary: DC Inside watch-gallery thread with a user sharing verified pros/cons of owning a Gucci watch; discussion includes mixed commentary on build quality versus brand cachet, typical of organic community product-experience chatter rather than press-driven coverage.

items.title: 激烈的对立——GUCCI2026秋冬秀场解读
items.summary: Zhihu long-form community post interpreting Gucci's 2026 FW show, describing sharply polarized reactions among Chinese fashion commentators to Demna's direction -- roughly split between those who see a confident reinvention and those who see the house drifting from its heritage identity. Genuine two-sided community debate, no clear resolved verdict.

items.title: [GUCCI X MARIAH CAREY] Gucci Gift 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: Official Gucci holiday campaign video featuring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, for the 2026 Gift collection. Pure brand-owned promotional content with no independent evaluative framing; counted as activation coverage only.

items.title: 구찌 3년넘게 쓰고 알려주는 솔직후기ㅣGUCCI 모아보기
items.summary: Independent Korean creator long-term-use review of multiple Gucci items (Padlock, Marmont, Horsebit and others) after 3+ years of ownership; mixes praise for design with candid notes on wear-and-tear, functioning as organic third-party product testimony rather than brand-supplied content.

items.title: 현대적인 화려함! 닝닝의 첫 LACMA 아트+필름 갈라 룩
items.summary: Vogue Korea styling write-up on aespa's Ningning's custom Gucci look at the LACMA Gala, described as a feathered jacket with crystal-embellished bra top and olive fur jacket. Descriptive fashion-editorial activation coverage, no independent critical verdict rendered.
